getBox.name: The Sunday Box
getBox.tagline: Six recipes, one kitchen, whoever is cooking

listRecipes.title: Leek and potato soup
listRecipes.method: Soften the leeks in the butter without colouring them. Add the potatoes and the stock, simmer until the potatoes give, then blend until smooth and season.

listRecipes.title: Beetroot with goat's curd
listRecipes.method: Slice the beetroot, dress it in the vinegar and some oil, then spoon the curd over and scatter the toasted walnuts.

listRecipes.title: Roast chicken with bread sauce
listRecipes.method: Roast the bird at 200 for twenty minutes a pound and twenty over. Warm the milk with the clove-studded onion, take the onion out, stir in the torn bread and let it thicken.

listRecipes.title: Aubergine and chickpea stew
listRecipes.method: Brown the aubergine in batches. Fry the garlic and cumin, add the tomatoes and chickpeas, return the aubergine and simmer until everything is soft.

listRecipes.title: Rice pudding
listRecipes.method: Everything in a buttered dish, nutmeg on top, then into a low oven for two hours. Do not stir it.

listRecipes.title: Poached pears
listRecipes.method: Peel the pears and leave the stalks on. Simmer them in the wine, sugar and cinnamon until a knife goes in without asking, then reduce the liquor to a syrup.

listNotes.text: The oven runs hot. Take twenty off whatever the recipe says.
Priya is vegetarian this month, so the stew is on twice.
Bread sauce wants stale bread. Buy the loaf on Thursday.
